questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: 4th year undergraduate courses - there is a big difference between the master and undergraduate course-structure. The master courses has very few hours and is mostly online in the evening and are in block structure, whereas the undergraduate courses are more like normal Uni. My recommendation do undergraduate if you wanna be a part of the university and live the uni-life. Do master courses if you just wanna have time to travel and party

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very different - it was like being in gymnasium again
